_README: Copy to ~/.hiring-scraper/credentials.json and fill in what you have. Every key is OPTIONAL — a missing credential skips one lane, it never fails the sweep. Environment variables of the same name always win over this file, which is how the restricted sandbox supplies them. Override the file location with HIRING_SCRAPER_CREDENTIALS. This file must never contain a real value.
_GITHUB_TOKEN: Fine-grained PAT, public-repo read is enough. Raises the API limit from 60 to 5000 req/hr. github.com/settings/tokens
_WAAS_COOKIE: The full Cookie: header from a browser logged in to workatastartup.com (DevTools → Network → any request → Request Headers → Cookie). Unlocks the YC candidate side. Expires; re-copy when the scraper reports a login bounce.
_OPENAI_API_KEY: Only used by judge_list.py, to grade a finished list with a model from a different family than the one that wrote it.
_EXA_API_KEY: Optional web/people search when the Exa MCP is not available (sandbox runtime).
_FIRECRAWL_API_KEY: Optional. Renders JS-heavy pages that plain curl cannot read.
_X_BEARER_TOKEN: Optional app-only bearer for X/Twitter search. Basic tier allows ~60 searches per 15 minutes.
_UNIPILE: Optional LinkedIn graph access (1st/2nd-degree search, mutuals). Profiles returned lack work history — verify A-bar legs elsewhere.
